title: Mobile Car Detailing in Shawnigan Lake: What to Expect and What It Costs
metaDescription: Looking for mobile car detailing in Shawnigan Lake, BC? Ashton's Auto Detailing brings professional exterior, interior, and full detail packages to your driveway.
excerpt: A look at what mobile detailing looks like for Shawnigan Lake residents, from gravel-driveway grime to lake-season interior cleanups, plus real pricing.

content.text: Shawnigan Lake has its own particular mix of dirt, dust, and debris that a car picks up between town and the water. Between the gravel roads around the lake, the fine dust that kicks up in summer, and the tree debris that drops from the forest canopy along Shawnigan Lake Road, vehicles here need a different level of attention than a car that only ever sees pavement in downtown Duncan. Ashton's Auto Detailing runs a fully mobile operation, which means we bring the water tank, generator, and full detailing kit right to your driveway anywhere around the lake, whether you're near the village, up on Shawnigan Lake Road, or out toward Sooke Lake Road.
Why Shawnigan Lake vehicles need extra attention

Gravel driveways and unpaved side roads are common around the lake, and that means brake dust, road grit, and fine silica dust cling to paint and wheel wells more aggressively than they do on a car that's parked on asphalt every day. Add in the sap and pollen that falls from the cedar and fir cover, and you end up with a paint surface that oxidizes and dulls faster without regular protection. On the interior side, lake season brings its own mess: wet swimsuits, sand tracked in from the public beach access, and the general damp-towel-and-sunscreen combination that soaks into carpets and seats through July and August.

items: Exterior Detail (from $89 sedan / $119 SUV / $139 truck) — hand wash, wheel and wheel-well degreasing, tar and sap removal, clay bar decontamination, and a protective wax or sealant

Interior Detail (from $139 sedan / $159 SUV / $179 truck) — full vacuum, steam cleaning of carpets and seats, sand and grit extraction from door jambs and floor mats, dash and console detailing, and interior glass
Full Detail (from $219 sedan / $249 SUV / $279 truck) — the complete exterior and interior service in one visit, ideal for a seasonal reset before or after lake season

content.text: How mobile detailing works at the lake

A lot of the vehicles we see around the lake are also daily-driven on the highway into Duncan or Victoria for work, so they're picking up commuter grime on top of lake-life mess. That combination is exactly why a full detail tends to make more sense here than an exterior-only wash: the interior needs the same reset the paint does.

We show up with everything we need, including our own water supply and power, so there's no hose or outlet required on your end. Most Shawnigan Lake appointments run 90 minutes to three hours depending on the package and how much sand and lake residue has built up. We work around gravel and sloped driveways regularly, so tight or uneven parking isn't a problem. If your vehicle spends more time near the water than most, we'd recommend a full detail every 8 to 10 weeks through the summer to keep sap, dust, and sand from becoming a permanent fixture in your carpets and paint.

We regularly book appointments throughout Shawnigan Lake, along with the rest of the Cowichan Valley including Duncan, Cobble Hill, Mill Bay, Cowichan Bay, Maple Bay, Chemainus, Crofton, Ladysmith, and Lake Cowichan. If you're not sure whether your address falls within our mobile service range, just give us a call and we'll confirm.
